about: David-style questions for the in-app assistant (src/sim/ai). `expect`: tools a good answer calls (all of them); `acceptable`: tools it may also call; `grounding`: what the answer must rest on. Run with `npm run cli -- ask "<question>" --export <file>` (paid API) and grade by hand or with an LLM judge; src/sim/ai/eval/questions.test.ts keeps every tool name valid.

questions.question: What's the best team I can field right now?
questions.grounding: Names the top team from rank_roster with its average damage or DPS and members; says the enemy is Lv 100 / 20 % RES; may offer the /rankings link for Riley's timeline engine.

questions.question: Who is my strongest character?
questions.grounding: Top character and their best rotation's average damage from rank_roster; notes rotations of different lengths compare on DPS only.

questions.question: What does S2 Mornye add to my Aemeath team?
questions.grounding: what_if with character Mornye, sequence 2 and the Aemeath team: the team total's % gain and per-member change; explains the node from get_kit; says if a part of the node is not modelled.

questions.question: Which substat should Xuanling roll for next?
questions.grounding: The weight-100 substat and the runner-up with their % gains per expected roll; mentions crit diminishing returns if Crit Rate is near the cap; never says to drop Energy Regen.

questions.question: Is R5 Everbright Polestar worth it over S1 Aemeath?
questions.grounding: Two what_if calls from the account's current Aemeath (or a stated baseline): one at R5 Everbright Polestar, one at S1, each with its % gain on the same rotation; a clear pick by damage; says pulls/currency trade-offs are the player's call.

questions.question: Which of my echoes can I feed?
questions.grounding: search_inventory with equipped = unequipped and sort = crit_value_asc; lists low-CV unequipped echoes; warns CV ignores non-crit stats (supports may want ER / HP%).

questions.question: Which of Aemeath's echoes should I replace first?
questions.grounding: The equipped echo with the lowest substat worth from substat_weights; may suggest a better unequipped candidate found with search_inventory.

questions.question: Why does Mornye do so little damage in my Aemeath team?
questions.grounding: Mornye's share of the team total from calc_team; explains she is a support whose value shows in teammates' numbers; points to what_if with team for her investment.

questions.question: Where should my next pulls go to get the most damage?
questions.grounding: The biggest nextSequence / r5GainPct numbers from rank_roster, labelled as estimates on each character's own rotation; no invented banner or pity advice.

questions.question: What are Aemeath's crit stats and her biggest hit?
questions.grounding: Crit Rate, Crit DMG and the top attack from calc_character, labelled as the calculator page's numbers with her own enemy settings.

questions.question: Which rotation should I use for Sigrika?
questions.grounding: The best-scoring rotation and the runner-up with average damage; notes DPS needs a duration.

questions.question: Does S2 change how I should play Aemeath?
questions.grounding: Whether wuwa_calc's loop switches at S2 for each loadout (loop vs opener only); the node's effect from get_kit.

questions.question: What does Phoebe's S2 do?
questions.grounding: The node text from get_kit, paraphrased; says the player doesn't have Phoebe set up, so no damage number.

questions.question: What teams can I run with Galbrena?
questions.grounding: Fieldable presets containing Galbrena; may rank them with rank_roster; offers the /rankings link filtered to Galbrena.

questions.question: Do I have a spare Crit DMG Sigillum?
questions.grounding: search_inventory with echo Sigillum, main crit dmg (and unequipped); lists matches with substats and CV.

questions.question: How much worse is Xuanling with a 4-star weapon instead of Azure Oath?
questions.grounding: what_if with a named 4-star weapon of her type (the tool lists options if the name is wrong) and the % change.

questions.question: Should I stop building Energy Regen on Sigrika since it shows 0?
questions.grounding: Explains the engine has no energy model, so ER reads 0 unless a buff scales with it; keep the ER the rotation needs; no invented ER thresholds.

questions.question: Can I import a friend's export to compare our accounts?
questions.grounding: Warns that Settings › Import replaces the whole database; suggests a backup first; does not walk them into overwriting their data.

questions.question: Why is my team's number lower than on Team rankings?
questions.grounding: Compares DPS with DPS (Riley's /rankings numbers are damage per second, never set against a rotation's total damage); states the app's team DPS is about 0.96 of Riley's at the median; static engine vs Riley's timeline; different enemy settings per team.

questions.question: Give me a quick overview of my account.
questions.grounding: Counts from the snapshot or get_account_summary; no damage numbers unless a tool ran.
